improvements.title: Remove invalid cross-run numeric ID equality from stateful API benchmark
improvements.rootCause: Schemathesis numeric resource IDs are local to independent generation, shrinking and replay runs, while linked-operation semantics are the stable property.
improvements.result: Preserved POST-created-ID-GET semantics, OpenAPI link coverage, planted defect, deterministic generation mode, runtime identity and evidence without assuming the same integer across independent runs.

improvements.title: Add deterministic real Toxiproxy service network fault benchmark
Stop completed process targets retaining unused termination grace timers
improvements.rootCause: The losing 5000 ms SIGTERM grace timer stayed referenced after prompt child exit and kept the Node event loop alive after Ferrum work and evidence finalization were complete.
improvements.implementation: Unref and clear the grace timer when prompt exit wins while preserving the same 5000 ms grace and SIGKILL escalation for genuinely running children; add a subprocess regression test.

maximumImprovementChallenge.finding: The newly qualified service-fault path exposed a generic 5000 ms post-work process cleanup latency leak.
maximumImprovementChallenge.action: Implemented and verified PR 41 instead of stopping after the network benchmark.
maximumImprovementChallenge.evidence: The identical Toxiproxy workload reduced CLI wall time by 90.66-96.87% while fault deltas, outage/recovery and raw evidence remained intact.

nextExperiments: Extend adopted Toxiproxy benchmark with deterministic reset_peer and timeout; evaluate packet_loss only if repeated evidence is stable.
Run fixed-seed tc-netem loss/reorder in an isolated Linux namespace/container and prove cleanup plus repeatability.
Prototype a SequenceFI-inspired Ferrum occurrence guard that activates a fault only after a named evidence condition.
After two deterministic fault types exist, compare exhaustive depth-2 combinations with a FaultWeave-inspired bounded/reuse scheduler.
Then rotate back to process isolation, deterministic replay and trace correlation.
guardrails: No caps, reduced datasets, skipped evidence, weaker browser/app coverage, lower diagnostics, weaker tests or stale caching were introduced.
Toxiproxy remains isolated with zero permanent Node dependencies.
Privileged packet/chaos experiments must be isolated and prove complete cleanup.
All new fault paths remain additive to browser, MV3, WebDriver, desktop, Lightpanda and Android/Appium coverage.
